preservation: All M2b source results remain unchanged; this index distinguishes superseded postprocessing artifacts from the current corrected outputs.

historical_preserved_superseded.m2b1_p2_physical_check.json: Initial coarse P2 output. Its gradient_at_center field stored the linear gradient-fit coefficients instead of the gradient intercept; use the corrected v2 output for that observable.
historical_preserved_superseded.m2b1_p2_h0.75_hc0.18.json: Initial medium P2 output with the same gradient_at_center labeling error; use the corrected v2 output.
historical_preserved_superseded.m2b_3d_preflight.json: Original M2b P1 physical-preflight output; retained as the failed-convergence baseline, not a validated model.

not_completed: P2 finite-device potential-value fit cross-check did not finish within the bounded local execution window.
Independent central/surface/end refinement, P2 Gaussian flux convergence, elementwise strong-form Laplacian, and converged higher multipoles were not completed.
